name: huyencobattu
description: Huyền Cơ Bát Tự - BaZi Analysis Platform

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev -w backendjs
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.start: node init && npm run start -w backendjs
scripts.build: node init && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.render-build: npm install --include=dev && npm run build -w frontend
